subject.title: Track OpenClaw seams needed for full imported-plugin parity

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a phased public-plugin-contract program for Babelfish parity, and if so which security-sensitive seam should be designed first?
rationale: The request adds new durable host SDK contracts across multiple runtime owners; source-level repair cannot determine the intended public API, security model, or delivery sequence.

options.title: Sponsor a phased contract design
options.body: Start with a narrowly specified approval or connector capability contract, including ownership, permission semantics, and compatibility tests, before considering the remaining projection seams.

options.title: Scope one non-security projection seam
options.body: Approve a limited design discussion for bundle LSP or validated settings projection while deferring approval and connector authority to a separate security review.

options.title: Keep Babelfish partial for now
options.body: Retain unsupported mappings until a maintainer has a concrete host API proposal and ownership commitment.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a phased contract design
recommendation.body: Start with a narrowly specified approval or connector capability contract, including ownership, permission semantics, and compatibility tests, before considering the remaining projection seams.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa authored the compatibility inventory and is the only supplied participant directly connected to the requested Babelfish parity work.
